Messages.Author: Sydnelson
Messages.Body:
ARDB Update Anarchs Unbond

To update download the following file:

www.dropbox.com/s/a2j5wg1zygny9yt/vtescsv.zip?dl=0

Open ARDB

Click in "File" > "Update Database From a File"

Choose the download file above

Wait until update is finish and restart ARDB.

For card images just download the following file to ARDB cardimages folder
www.dropbox.com/s/uud0vyngnvbpot9/au.zip?dl=0
